parts:
Mauricio,

I just verified that it works under this configuration:

[5] LC_TIME=English_United States.1252   

attached base packages:
[1] stats     graphics  grDevices utils     datasets  methods   base    

other attached packages:
[1] rstan_2.0.0   inline_0.3.11 Rcpp_0.10.2 

loaded via a namespace (and not attached):
[1] codetools_0.2-8 stats4_2.15.2   tools_2.15.2 



Did you make sure to clear out the old installation of RStan? The instructions are here:
https://github.com/stan-dev/rstan/wiki/RStan-Getting-Started#prepare


Under Windows using a 32-bit g++, which is what is installed with RTools, I believe we are still unable to use debug mode. So make sure this is set:
set_cppo('fast')

Please let us know if uninstalling the old version and then reinstalling RStan v2.0.0 works.



Daniel
